what: an R3 round on the four vertical edges of a 14x6x10 box: the two rounds on each 6 mm end face meet exactly (the face is used up)
method: box 14x6x10, R3 = half the end width on the four vertical edges: the two rounds of each end meet in a half cylinder, the section is a stadium: area 14*6 - (4-pi)*3^2 = 76.274, V = 762.74.
